negativeDiscrimination.title: Questions may be misleading
negativeDiscrimination.message: {count} question(s) have negative discrimination, meaning wrong answers correlate with higher overall scores.
negativeDiscrimination.explanation: This typically happens when questions are confusing, have incorrect answer keys, or measure something different than intended.
negativeDiscrimination.action2: Verify the correct answer is properly marked
negativeDiscrimination.action3: Consider removing or revising these questions

tooEasy.title: Questions may be too easy
tooEasy.message: {count} question(s) have very high success rates (p > 0.9), providing little differentiation.
tooEasy.explanation: When almost everyone answers correctly, the question does not help distinguish between skill levels.
tooEasy.action3: Consider replacing with more discriminating items

tooHard.title: Questions may be too difficult
tooHard.message: {count} question(s) have very low success rates (p < 0.2), which may frustrate test-takers.
tooHard.explanation: When almost no one answers correctly, the question may be beyond the expected skill level or poorly worded.
tooHard.action2: Ensure the content matches the target audience
tooHard.action3: Check if the correct answer is achievable

unreliableCompetencies.title: Test Reliability below recommended
unreliableCompetencies.message: {count} competency measurement(s) have Cronbach's Alpha below 0.6.
unreliableCompetencies.explanation: Test Reliability Score (Cronbach's Alpha) measures internal consistency. Low values suggest the questions may not be measuring the same underlying competency.
unreliableCompetencies.action1: Review questions for alignment with the competency
unreliableCompetencies.action2: Consider adding more questions to increase reliability
unreliableCompetencies.action3: Remove items that lower the overall reliability

probationItems.title: Many items awaiting validation
probationItems.message: {count} question(s) are still gathering data (< 50 responses).
probationItems.explanation: Psychometric metrics require sufficient response data to be reliable. Consider increasing test deployment.
probationItems.action1: Increase test deployment to gather more responses

allReliable.title: All competencies are reliable

allReliable.explanation: Your assessment instruments are performing well. Continue monitoring for any changes.
allReliable.action2: Monitor for any degradation over time

negativeRpb.title: Negative Question Effectiveness

negativeRpb.explanation: Wrong answers are correlating with higher overall scores. This suggests the question is confusing or the answer key may be incorrect.
